## Finding: work order identified; event review remains incomplete

The relevant Racine work order is **MO-25-09-1070**, internal ID **WO-2025-09-004**, for **Cooler Plate Pack**.

| Requested item | Verified result |
|---|---|
| September cost period | **Sep-25 — PER-COST-2025-09** |
| Exact Pending Close time | **2025-09-30T18:00:00** |
| Source transaction ID | Unavailable in the accessible records |
| Event amount | Unavailable |
| Exact event-created time | Unavailable |
| Minutes after Pending Close | Cannot calculate without the event-created time |
| Recorded accounting status | Unavailable |
| Status consistent with Oracle policy? | Cannot determine without the event details |

The accessible source contains work-order and cost-period rows, but **no cost-event rows**. The supporting records are restricted to the records-custodian role. Consequently, I cannot establish whether an event was created after Pending Close; this is **not a finding that no late event occurred**. The supplied Pending Close timestamp has no timezone designation.

### Oracle policy
Oracle’s *Cost Accounting Period Statuses and Transaction Accounting* states that newly created transactions falling in or before a Pending Close period **will not be staged or processed until the period is closed or reopened**. Transactions entered before Pending Close can continue processing. **Revenue lines, COGS recognition, and manual cost adjustments are exceptions** that continue processing after Pending Close.

Thus, processing a newly created, non-exempt transaction during Pending Close would be inconsistent with that policy—but the missing event type, timing, and recorded status prevent an event-specific conclusion.

**Sources:** supplied work-order and cost-period records; Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM Cost Management 26B, PDF page 233, printed page 225.

No database records were changed. The incomplete audit was saved to `/cache/work/worker_65f014a597ee/audit-report.json` and submitted with status **needs_evidence**. Completing it requires an authorized cost-event extract for **WO-2025-09-004**.
